item.text:
REVIEW_DECISION: REJECT
RISK_CLASS: high-impact
SUMMARY: The execution-receipt schema does not enforce the documented minimum evidence for acceptance. It permits an `accepted` receipt without producing-attempt identity, resolved model, adapter-command digest, patch digest, changed paths, scope measurements, or any recorded gate commands/results. It also leaves raw per-call telemetry unconstrained, so unknown counters may simply be omitted rather than explicitly retained as unavailable. This weakens harness-owned acceptance and immutable provenance.
FINDING: high|docs/factory-ng/schemas/factory.execution-receipt-v1.schema.json|An accepted receipt can validate with a bare model-call ID and no gates, patch identity, attempt identity, or explicit unavailable raw counters|The contract requires harness-recorded gates and separate raw telemetry, and acceptance cannot rely on model output or unverifiable omissions
REQUIRED_CHANGE: Define and require structured attempt/model/adapter/patch/scope/gate fields and per-call raw counters with explicit unavailable representation; condition `outcome: accepted` on complete successful harness gate records.
COUNTEREXAMPLE: The supplied valid-execution-receipt.json validates as accepted although `model_calls` contains only `{"id":"call-1"}` and the receipt contains no gate results or patch digest.
